chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah, from Mansur ibn al-'Abbas, from 'Amr ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Faddal and Ibn al-Jahm, from Abi al-Hasan عليه السلام. They said: We asked him about al-fuqqa', and he said:
"It is khamr, and regarding it is the hadd of the drinker of khamr."

key_terms.الْخَمْرِ: intoxicating wine, here the basis for the applied legal ruling
key_terms.الْفُقَّاعِ: al-fuqqa'; a fermented intoxicating drink discussed in legal rulings

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on al-fuqqa' in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: The hadith states that al-fuqqa' is treated as khamr. Accordingly, the legal punishment applied to one who drinks khamr applies to it as well, making this a concise jurisprudential ruling on intoxicants.
